Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: UNDP Compass scores Sudan's Identification at 4.38 (Stage 5: Federated). Sudan had a national ID system pre-conflict. However, integration with a data exchange layer is not evidenced, and conflict has disrupted functionality.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: UNDP Compass single source did not evidence a data-exchange link. Fresh reporting confirms the national digital ID 'SUDAPASS' formally launched 21 May 2026 (SUNA/Fana News) built in partnership with the Civil Registry, and the Baldna exchange platform already used national ID numbers to cross-check the Customs/Civil Registry systems from October 2025. However, the government's own May 2026 roadmap lists integration with health, education, judiciary and customs data exchange as a 1-3 year forward goal, so full or partial integration is not yet evidenced. Raised from Planned(2) to Under development(3); not higher because sector-wide integration is still prospective.

Definition: Level of public transparency regarding data exchange operations, governance, and data sharing agreements
Comments: UNDP Compass rates Open Government at 2.56 (Stage 3: regular info sharing, some stakeholder input). However, conflict severely limits transparency in practice. No public dashboard for data exchange operations.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate. Value Name differs from the scale label — usually cosmetic.
revision_notes: Since late 2025 the Ministry of Digital Transformation has held recurring public press conferences (corroborated independently by allAfrica and Telecompaper, Feb 2026) disclosing Baldna platform service counts and rollout progress, and the Cybersecurity Authority issued a public statement (29 May 2026) on the SUDAPASS data-governance/sovereignty framework. This is more than 'limited disclosure' but no dedicated public dashboard or formally published annual report on the exchange system itself was found, so this is a tentative move to Moderate(3) rather than High(4). FLAGGED FOR HUMAN REVIEW: evidence is press/state-media coverage of official statements rather than a published report, so confirm whether this meets the 'Annual Reports' threshold before finalising.
